mapper.update: UPDATE article SET views = views + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.title, a.slug, a.summary, a.cover_url, a.category_id, a.status, a.is_top, a.views, a.create_time, a.update_time, c.name AS category_name, c.slug AS category_slug FROM article a LEFT JOIN category c ON a.category_id = c.id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND c.slug = #{category}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM article_tag at JOIN tag t ON t.id = at.tag_id WHERE at.article_id = a.id AND t.slug = #{tag})
AND (a.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR a.content_md LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY a.is_top DESC, a.create_time DESC, a.id DESC
